lessons_used: Evidence for specific kinds of change remains thin, as each kind of change has only 1 test so far.
Sign-in hint (sign_in, hint) and sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) were helpful as both won their tests.
Finish copy changes (finish, copy) performed worse and hurt the finish rate.
No clear effect was seen for adoption, choose_path, finish (new_screen), and home changes.
Predictions were generally too high across almost all tests compared to noise-corrected results.
Predictions were too low for sign-in reordering (+1.5% predicted vs +6.6% noise-corrected).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Split Verification
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a split view layout featuring pet visual preview and official validation badge.
candidates.why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and long completion times (median 89s, mean 1017s), and users reported issues with pet visuals.

adoption_certificate.headline: Verify & Claim Your Pet
adoption_certificate.body: Confirm your pet details and claim your official certificate.

guard.reason: The adoption certificate config replaces the official stamp with a generic 'Verified Companion' badge, losing a required job of the screen.

candidates.title: Post Onboarding Desktop Pet Control Guide
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated onboarding screen right before final intro screen explaining desktop tray controls, hiding, and pet interaction.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets cited confusion on controlling/hiding/talking to pets after onboarding, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.

new_pet_controls_guide.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_pet_controls_guide.body: Click your pet to talk, right-click for settings menu, or double-click to hide it in your system tray.

components.text: Right-click anytime on the pet desktop icon for quick controls.

guard.reason: Adding a new controls guide screen before home_intro within onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off and 3 support tickets, but new screens require a full release and past tests show modest lift.

candidates.title: Guided Companion Story Flow
candidates.change: Rebuild the initial story and path selection experience into an interactive story scroll layout highlighting companion roles.
candidates.why: choose_path has a very high mean duration of 514s and drop-off to 76.2%, indicating users stall on deciding their path.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Explore how a virtual companion keeps you company while you work and play.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Path
choose_path.body: Select a ready-made companion or build your own custom pet.

guard.reason: Redesigning story and choose_path into a scroll carousel layout retains all required steps and screen jobs.

candidates.score_note: Interactive story rebuild is high effort with unproven history on choose_path changes.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Progress Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a spotlight stage with real-time rendering progress bars and desktop launch status.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a mean 2336s (median 201s), and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to open.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Launch
waiting.body: We are generating your pet animations and configuring desktop window overlay settings.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen into a spotlight view clearly shows the pet is being made.

candidates.score_note: Addressed by 3 support mails on waiting screen, but home redesigns have not shown clear positive patterns previously.

candidates.title: Sign In Cloud Restore Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit account recovery notice on sign_in reassuring users that logging in restores existing cloud pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (largest theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in syncs your existing pets and progress automatically across all desktop devices.

components.text: Cloud sync enabled: existing pets will load immediately after sign in.

guard.reason: Adding account recovery and cloud sync hints to sign_in complies with all onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence with 8 support mails, low implementation cost, and sign_in hints previously won their test.

candidates.title: Desk Pet Launch Readiness Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop readiness notification toggle and system tray tips on the waiting screen while pet assets render.
candidates.why: Home waiting duration mean is 2336s, causing users to abandon or assume app installation stalled.

waiting.hint: Your pet will automatically appear on your desktop once rendering finishes.

guard.reason: Adding readiness notification options and rendering tips on the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Previous test for home wait_info yielded +0.0% lift despite high duration.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Trait Badges Showcase
candidates.change: Add companion personality and behavioral style badges on the pick_friend selection view.
candidates.why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and 89s median time due to hesitation during pet selection.

guard.reason: Adding personality trait badges to pick_friend preserves pet selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption loses the most users (60.9% conversion), though evidence for trait badges specifically is limited.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Mascot Welcome Banner
candidates.change: Add an interactive pet mascot welcome card and completion instructions to the home intro finish screen.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with high mean time (5815s) as users are unsure if onboarding completed.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look at the bottom corner of your screen to meet your new pet.

components.text: Hi! I am live on your desktop. Click me anytime to interact!

guard.reason: Adding a mascot welcome card to home_intro is an allowed modification inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step copy/banner updates previously hurt finish completion rates.

candidates.title: Path Choice Time Estimate Header
candidates.change: Add step counter and time estimate headers on choose_path screen.
candidates.why: choose_path has mean duration 514s and 76.2% conversion.

choose_path.headline: Pick Your Companion Path
choose_path.body: Select a pre-made pet or build a custom pet (takes under 2 minutes).

guard.reason: Adding step counters and time estimates to choose_path retains both path options and does not introduce dark patterns.

candidates.score_note: Cheap config/copy change to address long time on choose_path, but lift expected to be minimal.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Rendering Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Add photo quality requirements and lighting guidelines to the photo upload screen for custom pet creation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering outcomes.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload clear front-facing photos with good lighting and clear face outlines.

guard.reason: Requests personal information by asking the user to upload photos of their face.

picked: Post Onboarding Desktop Pet Control Guide
lessons_next: Evidence for most specific kinds of change remains thin, as only sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) have reached 2 tests.

Finish copy changes (finish, copy) performed worse and hurt the finish rate.
No clear effect was seen for adoption, choose_path, finish (new_screen), and home (new_flow, wait_info) changes.
Predictions were generally too high across almost all tests compared to noise-corrected results.
